about_the_game:
Are you ready to descend into terror? In this first-person psychological horror game inspired by the twisted worlds of H.P. Lovecraft, nothing is as it seems.

Tucked away in a modest house on the edge of a small suburban town, your days pass quietly. Just you and your dog — until a choking, otherworldly fog engulfs your home, shrouding the world in shadows and unleashing grotesque, other-dimensional creatures.

Thick, unnatural, and eerily silent, the fog swallows the town whole. People disappear. Shadows move where light should be. And the once-familiar streets twist into something unrecognizable. As nightmarish creatures creep out from the mist, you and your dog are thrust into a desperate struggle for survival.

GAME FEATURES

  • Experience a deeply atmospheric world where cosmic horrors lurk just beyond your vision. The ever-thickening fog conceals creatures too monstrous for reason, and every step forward is a descent into madness.

  • You're not just fighting what’s outside — you’re also battling the war within. As a small-town doctor, your medical duties begin to warp in surreal and terrifying ways. Each decision, each encounter chips away at your grip on reality.

  • Your dog isn’t just a companion — he’s your anchor to what’s left of the world. Watch his behavior closely; sometimes he sees the terror long before you do

  • Manage dwindling resources, scavenge for food, and patch yourself up in a world where supplies are scarce and danger is constant. Every choice could be your last.

  • This isn’t a quick scare – it's a slow, dread-filled journey through a decaying reality. Expect prolonged, tense sessions where your nerves will be tested at every turn.

name: Netherwake

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4350, 3,6 GHz / AMD Phenom X6, 3 GHz
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 265
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770, 3.5 GHz / AMD FX-8350, 4.0 GHz, Ryzen 5 - 1400 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1070 / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

short_description: Experience a nerve-racking adventure as a thick, dark fog begins to roll into the small town from the surrounding forests, and with it come ancient, cosmic beings from outside our reality. Try to survive and pray that you will one day see the sunlight again.
supported_languages:
English*, Japanese, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
